project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Supabase, React Router 6
build_system: Vite 5 + npm. Build runs: vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs (produces 398 static pages). Admin pages must NOT be in prerender.
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via build success
verification_instructions: Run npm run build which does vite build + prerender.mjs producing 398 pages. Admin pages must not appear in prerender. Build must exit 0.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated by build but not checked into git. No snapshot files.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install npm packages. Node v22.23.2 at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin.
contribution_requirements: npm run build must pass. Admin pages must not be added to prerender staticPages array. Admin pages render without site Navbar/Footer.
key_patterns: Admin pages in src/pages/admin/. Lazy-loaded in App.jsx. supabaseAdmin.js provides getAdminClient(). markdownToBlocks.js converts markdown to blocks array. ArticleBlocks.jsx renders blocks. Supported: string->paragraph, {h}->H2, {sub}->H3, {bullets}->bullet list, {list}->checkmark list, {quote}->blockquote, {table}->table, **bold** inline. NO images, NO colors, NO italic standalone.
directory_structure: src/pages/admin/ - admin pages. src/components/ui/ - shared UI components. src/utils/ - utilities like markdownToBlocks. src/lib/ - supabase client. scripts/ - build scripts including prerender.mjs.
